thread:
sam_partner: Quick heads-up — we need a telemetry submission checklist for the joint driver hotfix deliverable this week. Partner wants per-region metrics and kernel ooms before we press the patch.
alex_park: on it. can you confirm which driver + cuda/rocm versions they expect pinned?
maria_gomez: partner asked for nvidia 535.54 / cuda 12.2 and rocm 5.7 for AMD. also wants a fallback to 535.37 if 535.54 regresses.
kevin_release: schedule note: GA push target = Tue 09:00 PT. we need canary in eu-west1 and us-east1 24h prior. :alarm_clock: 
tj_oncall: what telemetry buckets do we need? tail latency, p50/p95/p99, token-throughput, gpu-sched-stalls, kernel-ooms?
alex_park: yes. add driver-modprobe errors, dmesg OOM lines, nvml memory alloc failures, and our per-model tail-latency. sequence-length broken down too.
sam_partner: partner will provide their marketplace IDs; they also want a single upload endpoint for artifact + telemetry. propose `curl -X POST https://telemetry.redwood.ai/partner-uploads --form 'file=@report.zip' --form 'meta=@meta.json'`
kevin_release: include manifest snippet in the checklist and ensure sha256 checksum
kevin_release: ```json
{
  "image": "gcr.io/redwood/rt:1.2.3-53554",
  "driver": "nvidia-535.54",
  "cuda": "12.2",
  "rocm": "5.7"
}
```
maria_gomez: gating criteria for canary: no increase >5% in p95 latency, no OOMs, no CPU steal >10%, and token throughput within -10% of baseline.
tj_oncall: add automated rollback hook: if any SEP alert fires, canary auto-rolls to previous driver within 5m. we need the rollback playbook snippet in the checklist.
sam_partner: partner legal asked that telemetry contains only aggregated metrics, no customer prompts or tokens. confirm we filter personally identifiable content.
alex_park: confirmed — only aggregated counters and anonymized hashes. add that to checklist item 4.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary-start 1794585600 (24h before GA), region: eu-west1, us-east1. :white_check_mark: 
kevin_release: final actions list — (1) engineering attach manifest+sha (2) partner upload endpoint tested (3) canary gating alerts wired to ops (4) comms embargo lift time confirmed with partner (5) press FAQ draft reviewed.
sam_partner: i'll coordinate partner-side upload tomorrow morning and send marketplace IDs. pls @kevin_release once checklist is updated.
alex_park: i'll put the checklist into the release doc and link here: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/driver-hotfix-1794500000
maria_gomez: ack. will run smoke on rocm node pool tonight and post results in the doc.
kevin_release: if all green by 03:00 PT tomorrow, we proceed with canary. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
